signature.name: Hungarian Parliament Building
signature.detail: This riverside neo-Gothic palace is Budapest's defining silhouette and home to the Holy Crown. Book a guided interior tour in advance, and view the facade best from the Danube bank at dusk.

signature.name: Buda Castle
signature.detail: The hilltop palace complex dominates the skyline and houses the Hungarian National Gallery. Take the funicular or a short walk up, and go early to avoid crowds.

signature.name: Fisherman's Bastion
signature.detail: A fairy-tale terrace with the best panorama over the Danube and Parliament. Visit at sunrise or after dark for fewer people and dramatic light.

signature.name: Széchenyi Chain Bridge
signature.detail: The iconic suspension bridge links Buda and Pest and is a symbol of the city. Walk across at night when it is illuminated, and combine it with a stroll to the Castle.

signature.name: St. Stephen's Basilica
signature.detail: Budapest's largest church, with a dome you can climb for sweeping views. Dress modestly, and time your visit to hear the organ or see the relic.

signature.name: Heroes' Square
signature.detail: A grand monument to Hungarian history at the end of Andrássy Avenue. Pair it with a visit to the City Park and Vajdahunyad Castle behind it.

signature.name: Széchenyi Thermal Baths
signature.detail: One of Europe's largest thermal bath complexes, with outdoor pools and stunning architecture. Bring a swim cap and towel, and go on a weekday morning to avoid queues.
